concerns.text: FR-009 and SC-003 explicitly mandate sensitivity analysis for window sizes {20, 30, 40} TRs. Tasks T021b and T029b describe implementing a generic 'range of window sizes' without specifying these exact values. This semantic weakening risks the implementation using a different set (e.g., {25, 30, 35}), failing the specific success criterion.

FR-010 requires a fail-fast exit if valid subjects < 50. T013 states 'Do not write metrics files in this case.' However, SC-005 requires measuring the 'percentage of subjects that pass validation' even when the system fails. By suppressing the metrics file on failure, the task prevents the verification of SC-005, effectively dropping an acceptance criterion.

The plan.md defines `code/main.py` as the orchestration entry point (Phase 2). Task T041 is marked incomplete (unchecked) and identifies that this script is missing. Without this entry point, the pipeline cannot be executed to satisfy any user story or the Constitution's Reproducibility principle (Principle I).

Spec SC-001 and FR-001 define the memory constraint as < 7 GB. Task T037a arbitrarily tightens this to < 6 GB without a documented justification (e.g., overhead buffer). This is a silent relaxation of the spec's defined boundary, potentially forcing unnecessary optimization work or creating a conflict if the 7GB limit is the hard constraint.

FR-002 requires excluding Power 264 nodes overlapping with the Ventral Striatum (VS) to prevent double-dipping. While T016c extracts VS and T016 excludes nodes, neither task mandates writing the *excluded* node list to a separate artifact or log. This omission violates the 'Data Hygiene' (Constitution III) and 'Neuroimaging Processing Standards' (Constitution VI) by failing to provide an auditable record of the exclusion logic execution.
